title: Common definitions
description: Shared building blocks reused across every portfolio data schema (experience, projects, education, certifications, etc). Centralizing them here avoids redefining the same shape in multiple files and keeps every collection consistent.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier, conventionally prefixed by type (e.g. "exp-finnegans-ai-developer", "skill-python", "proj-cachibache-app"). Other files and AI tools reference entries by this id.

yearMonth.description: Partial ISO-8601 date with year and month only, e.g. "2025-03".

tags.description: Free-form lowercase keywords used for search/filtering by AI tools (e.g. ["ai", "backend", "aws"]).

link.description: A single outbound link (repo, live demo, article, social profile, etc).

label.description: Human readable label, e.g. "Repository" or "Live demo".

media.description: A single image/video/gif asset associated with an entry.

teamMember.description: A collaborator credited on a shared project.
